fullName: Host · List with KAVE [H-LRQ-03] Sending the request confirms it @mutating @data-dependent — SKIPPED: the List with KAVE banner is not offered to the host in QA (not eligible, or no active banner)
description:
Let KAVE create your listing (Host manual ch. 4).

The "List with KAVE" banner on step 1 only shows while the backend says the
host is eligible, so H-LRQ-01…03 depend on QA data.
